metric: Value metric (charter): time to make a RAID log with a human review
method: The owner opened each sample in the live demo and timed the check of every item against its source quote. Tool time is the eval run 2 time for the same sample.
result: About 27 seconds with the tool and a review, against 6 to 8 minutes by hand: 92% to 94% less time on s02 and s05.
limits: s01 has no manual time: the manual baseline used s07, which is not in the demo. Only s02 and s05 compare directly.
The samples are short (about 150 words). A 1-hour call was not timed by hand.
The owner had seen these samples before, which can make the review faster.
